article.story: CHENEY, Wash. -- — Christian King had 27 points off the bench in Montana State's 68-64 win against Eastern Washington on Thursday. King had seven rebounds for the Bobcats (9-7, 3-0 Big Sky Conference). Patrick McMahon scored 20 points while shooting 7 of 13 from the field and 6 for 8 from the line and added five rebounds. The Eagles (2-13, 0-2) were led in scoring by Isaiah Moses, who finished with 24 points. Kiree Huie added 15 points and two blocks for Eastern Washington. The loss was the Eagles' sixth in a row. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
